_readme: Hand-curated from official public pages. Every record stays needs_verification until a person checks it against source_url, fixes any wrong values, then sets verification_status to verified and last_checked_at to the check date (YYYY-MM-DD). Hindi text is machine-drafted: set hi_reviewed true only after a fluent reviewer checks it.

schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Landholding farmer families
schemes.description_en: Direct income support for landholding farmer families, paid into their bank account.
schemes.description_hi: ज़मीन वाले किसान परिवारों को सीधे बैंक खाते में आय सहायता।
schemes.benefits: Income support of Rs 6,000 per year, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer.
schemes.eligibility_text: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their name. Exclusions include institutional landholders, income-tax payers, holders of constitutional posts, serving or retired government employees (with some exceptions), and certain professionals.
application_steps: Open the PM-KISAN portal and choose New Farmer Registration, or visit a Common Service Centre.
Enter Aadhaar, land and bank details.
Complete e-KYC.
Track status with Know Your Status on the portal.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm amount, exclusion list and e-KYC requirement on the portal FAQ.

schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Farmers, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers, growing notified crops in notified areas
schemes.description_en: Crop insurance against crop loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases, at a low farmer premium.
schemes.description_hi: प्राकृतिक आपदा, कीट और रोग से फसल नुकसान पर कम प्रीमियम वाला फसल बीमा।
schemes.benefits: Insurance cover for notified crops. Farmer premium is capped (commonly 2% for kharif, 1.5% for rabi, 5% for commercial and horticultural crops); the rest is shared by central and state governments.
schemes.eligibility_text: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers. Enrolment is within the season's cut-off dates.
application_steps: Apply through your bank, a Common Service Centre, an insurance company agent, or the PMFBY portal.
Choose the notified crop and area.
Pay the farmer share of premium.
Keep the policy receipt.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm premium caps and current season cut-off dates; do not show dates unless verified.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and those in animal husbandry and fisheries
schemes.description_en: A credit card from banks that gives farmers timely short-term loans for crops and allied activities.
schemes.description_hi: बैंकों से किसानों को फसल और संबंधित कामों के लिए समय पर अल्पकालिक ऋण।
schemes.benefits: Short-term credit for cultivation and allied activities. Interest subvention is available on loans up to a limit, with an extra incentive for prompt repayment.
schemes.eligibility_text: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, self-help groups or joint liability groups of farmers, and farmers in animal husbandry or fisheries.
documents_required: Land records or proof of cultivation
application_steps: Visit your bank branch or apply online where your bank allows it.
Submit the KCC form with documents.
Bank assesses the credit limit.
Card is issued after approval.
schemes.curation_notes: Find the exact KCC page on agriwelfare.gov.in or myscheme.gov.in; confirm interest subvention figures.

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: All farmers
schemes.description_en: Free soil testing with a card that recommends nutrients and fertiliser for your field.
schemes.description_hi: मुफ्त मिट्टी जांच और खेत के लिए खाद व पोषक तत्वों की सलाह वाला कार्ड।
schemes.benefits: Soil sample tested free of cost. The card shows soil nutrient status and crop-wise fertiliser recommendations.
schemes.eligibility_text: Open to all farmers.
application_steps: Contact the local agriculture department office or Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
Soil sample is collected from your field.
Download or collect the card from the Soil Health Card portal.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm current process on the portal.

schemes.name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री किसान ऊर्जा सुरक्षा एवं उत्थान महाभियान (पीएम-कुसुम)
schemes.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives and panchayats
schemes.description_en: Subsidy for solar irrigation pumps and for solarising existing grid-connected pumps.
schemes.description_hi: सौर सिंचाई पंप लगाने और मौजूदा पंपों को सौर ऊर्जा से चलाने के लिए सब्सिडी।
schemes.benefits: Central financial assistance for standalone solar pumps and pump solarisation, with state support; higher central share in North-Eastern and hill states. Exact shares must be checked on the official page.
schemes.eligibility_text: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, FPOs, cooperatives and panchayats, through the state implementing agency.
documents_required: Farmer registration with the state agency
application_steps: Apply through your state implementing agency's PM-KUSUM portal.
Pay the farmer share after selection.
Pump is installed by an empanelled vendor.
schemes.curation_notes: Verify subsidy shares and Uttarakhand implementing agency (UREDA) link.

schemes.department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Adult women from poor households without an LPG connection
schemes.description_en: Deposit-free LPG connection for women from poor households.
schemes.description_hi: गरीब परिवारों की महिलाओं को बिना जमा राशि के एलपीजी कनेक्शन।
schemes.benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection. Check the official page for current refill support.
schemes.eligibility_text: Adult woman (18+) from a poor household as defined by the scheme, with no existing LPG connection in the household.
documents_required: Ration card or other family identity document
application_steps: Apply online on the PMUY portal or at the nearest LPG distributor.
Submit KYC and household documents.
Connection is released after verification.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm list of eligible household categories and any refill subsidy amounts.

schemes.department: Ministry of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Parents or guardians of a girl child below 10 years
schemes.description_en: A small-savings account for a girl child, opened by a parent or guardian, with government-set interest.
schemes.description_hi: बेटी के लिए छोटी बचत योजना, जिसे माता-पिता या अभिभावक खोलते हैं; ब्याज दर सरकार तय करती है।
schemes.benefits: Savings account for the girl child with interest set by the government each quarter; deposits qualify for income-tax deduction under Section 80C.
schemes.eligibility_text: Account opened in the name of a girl child below 10 years by a parent or legal guardian. Limits apply on the number of accounts per family and on yearly deposits.
documents_required: Birth certificate of the girl child
Identity and address proof of parent/guardian
application_steps: Visit a post office or an authorised bank.
Fill the account opening form.
Make the first deposit.
schemes.curation_notes: Rules intentionally null: eligibility depends on the daughter's age, not the person using the checker. Confirm deposit limits and current interest rate.

schemes.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Pregnant women and lactating mothers
schemes.description_en: Cash support to pregnant women and new mothers to support rest and nutrition.
schemes.description_hi: गर्भवती महिलाओं और नई माताओं को आराम और पोषण के लिए नकद सहायता।
schemes.benefits: Cash incentive for the first child in instalments, and for a second child if the second child is a girl (as revised under Mission Shakti). Confirm amounts on the official page.
schemes.eligibility_text: Pregnant women and lactating mothers meeting the scheme's criteria; government employees receiving similar benefits are excluded.
application_steps: Register at the Anganwadi centre or health facility, or on the PMMVY portal.
Submit the form with documents.
Instalments are paid by DBT after conditions are met.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm current amounts (PMMVY 2.0) and eligibility categories.

schemes.department: Department of Women Empowerment and Child Development, Uttarakhand
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Girls from eligible families in Uttarakhand
schemes.description_en: Uttarakhand financial assistance for girls, at birth and after passing class 12.
schemes.description_hi: उत्तराखंड में बालिकाओं को जन्म पर और कक्षा 12 पास करने पर आर्थिक सहायता।
schemes.benefits: One-time assistance at the birth of a girl and on passing class 12. Confirm current amounts on the official page.
schemes.eligibility_text: Girls from Uttarakhand families meeting the scheme's income limit; conditions on the number of girls per family and application time limits apply.
application_steps: Apply on the department's portal or at the Anganwadi/CDPO office within the time limit.
Submit documents.
Track application status.
schemes.curation_notes: Merged from the earlier Nanda Devi Kanya Dhan and Gaura Devi Kanya Dhan schemes. Income limit 72000 is a DRAFT value from memory: verify before marking verified.

schemes.department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (National Health Mission)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Pregnant women delivering in government or accredited health facilities
schemes.description_en: Cash assistance to encourage safe delivery in a health facility.
schemes.description_hi: अस्पताल में सुरक्षित प्रसव को बढ़ावा देने के लिए नकद सहायता।
schemes.benefits: Cash assistance for institutional delivery; amounts differ by state category and rural or urban area.
schemes.eligibility_text: Pregnant women, with conditions that differ between low-performing and high-performing states.
documents_required: BPL or category certificate where required
application_steps: Register the pregnancy with the ASHA worker or health centre.
Deliver at a government or accredited facility.
Assistance is paid to the bank account.
schemes.curation_notes: Find the JSY page on nhm.gov.in; confirm amounts for Uttarakhand.

schemes.name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.department: National Health Authority
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Eligible poor and vulnerable families; all senior citizens aged 70+
schemes.description_en: Free hospital treatment cover at empanelled public and private hospitals.
schemes.description_hi: सूचीबद्ध सरकारी और निजी अस्पतालों में मुफ्त इलाज का बीमा कवर।
schemes.benefits: Health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation, cashless at empanelled hospitals.
schemes.eligibility_text: Families identified by the scheme's deprivation and occupational criteria and later expansions; senior citizens aged 70 and above are covered regardless of income.
documents_required: Ration card or PM letter (if available)
application_steps: Check eligibility on the beneficiary portal or at an empanelled hospital.
Complete e-KYC.
Download the Ayushman card.
schemes.curation_notes: Rule using is_bpl is a simplification; real identification uses SECC/state lists. Prefer rules that send users to the beneficiary check.

schemes.department: State Health Authority, Uttarakhand
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Families in Uttarakhand
schemes.description_en: Uttarakhand health cover for families, run alongside Ayushman Bharat.
schemes.description_hi: उत्तराखंड के परिवारों के लिए स्वास्थ्य बीमा कवर, आयुष्मान भारत के साथ।
schemes.benefits: Cashless treatment cover at empanelled hospitals. Confirm cover amount on the official page.
schemes.eligibility_text: Families resident in Uttarakhand, as defined by the State Health Authority.
application_steps: Visit a CSC or empanelled hospital.
Complete card registration.
Use the card for cashless treatment.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm coverage amount and any exclusions for government employees.

schemes.department: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Bank or post office account holders aged 18-70
schemes.description_en: Low-cost accident insurance renewed every year through your bank account.
schemes.description_hi: बैंक खाते से हर साल नवीनीकृत होने वाला सस्ता दुर्घटना बीमा।
schemes.benefits: Accident cover of Rs 2 lakh for death or full disability and Rs 1 lakh for partial disability, for a small yearly premium auto-debited from the account.
schemes.eligibility_text: Account holders aged 18 to 70 who give consent for auto-debit.
documents_required: Bank or post office savings account
application_steps: Enrol through your bank branch, net banking, or the Jan Suraksha portal.
Give auto-debit consent.
Keep the acknowledgement.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm current premium amount.

schemes.department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Citizens aged 18-40, mainly in the unorganised sector
schemes.description_en: A pension plan where your monthly contributions give a guaranteed pension after age 60.
schemes.description_hi: हर महीने योगदान करें और 60 साल के बाद तय पेंशन पाएं।
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension from age 60, in fixed slabs between Rs 1,000 and Rs 5,000 depending on contribution; pension continues to the spouse, and the corpus goes to the nominee.
schemes.eligibility_text: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank account. Income-tax payers are not eligible to join (from 1 October 2022).
application_steps: Apply through your bank branch or net banking.
Choose the pension amount.
Contributions are auto-debited.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm income-tax payer exclusion and slab details.

schemes.name_en: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (NSAP)
schemes.name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
schemes.department: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60+ from BPL households
schemes.description_en: Monthly pension for elderly people from below-poverty-line households; states often add their own amount.
schemes.description_hi: गरीबी रेखा से नीचे के परिवारों के बुजुर्गों को मासिक पेंशन; कई राज्य अपनी राशि जोड़ते हैं।
schemes.benefits: Central monthly pension (higher for those aged 80+), plus any state top-up. Check your state's total amount.
schemes.eligibility_text: Persons aged 60 or above belonging to a BPL household.
application_steps: Apply at the block office, municipality, or state social welfare portal.
Submit documents for verification.
Pension is paid by DBT after sanction.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm central amounts and Uttarakhand state top-up and application route.

schemes.department: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Non-farm micro and small enterprises
schemes.description_en: Collateral-free loans from banks and lenders to start or grow a small business.
schemes.description_hi: छोटा व्यापार शुरू करने या बढ़ाने के लिए बिना गारंटी का ऋण।
schemes.benefits: Loans in categories Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus, with increasing limits. Confirm current limits on the official page.
schemes.eligibility_text: Indian citizens with a business plan for a non-farm income-generating activity in manufacturing, trading or services, including allied agricultural activities.
application_steps: Approach a bank, NBFC or MFI, or apply on the JanSamarth portal.
Submit the loan application with documents.
Lender appraises and sanctions the loan.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm loan limits including Tarun Plus.

schemes.department: Department of Financial Services (via SIDBI)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Women and SC/ST entrepreneurs starting a new enterprise
schemes.description_en: Bank loans for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs setting up a new (greenfield) business.
schemes.description_hi: महिलाओं और अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति के उद्यमियों को नया व्यापार शुरू करने के लिए बैंक ऋण।
schemes.benefits: Bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore for a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading or allied agriculture.
schemes.eligibility_text: Women, or SC/ST individuals, aged 18 or above, setting up a greenfield enterprise; for non-individual enterprises, at least 51% shareholding and control must be with such a person. Borrower should not be in default to any bank.
application_steps: Register on the Stand-Up Mitra portal or approach a bank branch.
Prepare the project report.
Bank appraises and sanctions the loan.
schemes.curation_notes: social_category is asked only because this scheme's rule uses it. Confirm loan range.

schemes.name_en: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.name_hi: कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय छात्रों के लिए केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति योजना
schemes.department: Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Meritorious students from low-income families in regular college courses
schemes.description_en: Scholarship for students who scored in the top percentile of their class 12 board and study in regular college courses.
schemes.description_hi: कक्षा 12 में बोर्ड के शीर्ष प्रतिशत में आए और नियमित कॉलेज कोर्स कर रहे छात्रों के लिए छात्रवृत्ति।
schemes.benefits: Yearly scholarship for graduation and post-graduation in regular courses. Confirm current amounts on NSP.
schemes.eligibility_text: Students above the 80th percentile in their class 12 board, in regular degree courses (not correspondence or diploma), with family income within the scheme limit, and not availing other scholarships.
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
Fill the application and upload documents.
Institute and state verify the application.
Scholarship is paid by DBT.
schemes.curation_notes: Income limit 4.5 lakh is DRAFT from memory; verify on NSP scheme guidelines.

schemes.department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Girl students in AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma courses
schemes.description_en: Scholarship for girls admitted to technical degree or diploma courses at AICTE-approved institutions.
schemes.description_hi: एआईसीटीई मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों में तकनीकी डिग्री या डिप्लोमा में दाखिल छात्राओं के लिए छात्रवृत्ति।
schemes.benefits: Yearly scholarship for the course duration as per AICTE guidelines. Confirm current amount.
schemes.eligibility_text: Girl students admitted to the first year (or second year via lateral entry) of an AICTE-approved degree or diploma, family income within the limit, at most two girls per family.
application_steps: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal.
Institute verifies the application.
Scholarship paid by DBT.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm amount and income limit for the current year.

schemes.name_en: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-abled Students
schemes.name_hi: एआईसीटीई सक्षम छात्रवृत्ति (दिव्यांग छात्रों के लिए)
schemes.department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Specially-abled students in AICTE-approved technical courses
schemes.description_en: Scholarship for students with disabilities studying technical degree or diploma courses.
schemes.description_hi: तकनीकी डिग्री या डिप्लोमा पढ़ रहे दिव्यांग छात्रों के लिए छात्रवृत्ति।
schemes.benefits: Yearly scholarship for the course duration as per AICTE guidelines. Confirm current amount.
schemes.eligibility_text: Students with a disability of at least 40%, admitted to an AICTE-approved degree or diploma course, with family income within the limit.
application_steps: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal.
Institute verifies the application.
Scholarship paid by DBT.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm amount and income limit.

schemes.name_en: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.target_beneficiaries: SC students studying after class 10
schemes.description_en: Support for fees and study costs for Scheduled Caste students in class 11 and above.
schemes.description_hi: कक्षा 11 और उससे आगे पढ़ने वाले अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों को फीस और पढ़ाई के खर्च में सहायता।
schemes.benefits: Reimbursement of compulsory fees and an academic allowance, as per scheme norms. Applied through state portals.
schemes.eligibility_text: Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matric level whose family income is within the scheme limit.
application_steps: Apply on your state scholarship portal (Uttarakhand: scholarship.uk.gov.in) or NSP as notified.
Institute verifies.
Payment by DBT.
schemes.curation_notes: social_category asked only because the rule requires it. Confirm income limit and Uttarakhand application route.

schemes.department: Ministry of Education (Department of School Education and Literacy)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Meritorious students from low-income families in classes 9 to 12
schemes.description_en: Scholarship for students selected through a state exam in class 8, to help them continue school.
schemes.description_hi: कक्षा 8 में राज्य परीक्षा से चुने गए छात्रों को आगे पढ़ाई जारी रखने के लिए छात्रवृत्ति।
schemes.benefits: Yearly scholarship from class 9 to 12 in government, aided or local body schools. Confirm current amount.
schemes.eligibility_text: Students who clear the state NMMS selection exam in class 8, study in government/aided/local body schools, and whose family income is within the limit.
application_steps: Appear in the state NMMS exam in class 8.
Selected students apply/renew on NSP.
Payment by DBT.
schemes.curation_notes: Confirm amount and income limit.

schemes.name_hi: अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.department: Ministry of Minority Affairs
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Students from notified minority communities studying after class 10
schemes.description_en: Scholarship for students from notified minority communities in class 11 and above.
schemes.description_hi: अधिसूचित अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों के कक्षा 11 और आगे के छात्रों के लिए छात्रवृत्ति।
schemes.benefits: Admission/tuition fee support and maintenance allowance as per scheme norms.
schemes.eligibility_text: Students from notified minority communities with minimum marks in the previous exam and family income within the scheme limit.
application_steps: Apply on NSP when the scheme is open.
Institute verifies.
Payment by DBT.
schemes.curation_notes: Asks only yes/no about a notified minority community, because the rule requires it. Confirm the scheme is open this year.

schemes.department: Social Welfare Department, Uttarakhand
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Students resident in Uttarakhand
schemes.description_en: The Uttarakhand portal where students apply for state-administered pre-matric and post-matric scholarships.
schemes.description_hi: उत्तराखंड का पोर्टल जहाँ छात्र राज्य द्वारा चलाई जाने वाली प्री-मैट्रिक और पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्तियों के लिए आवेदन करते हैं।
schemes.benefits: Benefits depend on the specific scholarship selected on the portal.
schemes.eligibility_text: Students resident in Uttarakhand; each scholarship on the portal has its own category, income and course conditions.
application_steps: Register on the Uttarakhand scholarship portal.
Choose the scholarship you qualify for.
Submit and get institute verification.
schemes.curation_notes: Consider splitting into individual schemes once each is verified on the portal.

schemes.department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Youth seeking skill training and certification
schemes.description_en: Free short-term skill training with government certification to help youth get jobs.
schemes.description_hi: युवाओं को रोजगार के लिए मुफ्त अल्पकालिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण और सरकारी प्रमाणपत्र।
schemes.benefits: Free short-term training at accredited centres, assessment and certification. Confirm current scheme phase.
schemes.eligibility_text: Indian youth meeting the age and education requirements of the chosen course.
application_steps: Find a training centre on the Skill India Digital portal.
Enrol in a course.
Complete training and assessment to get certified.
schemes.curation_notes: Age range not encoded until verified for the current phase.
